description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SecurityNotAllowedFilterError' used within Twig's sandbox security system to indicate when a not permitted filter is used in a template.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedFilterError
classes.description: An exception indicating that a filter used in a template is not allowed by the security policy.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message and the name of the filter that was not allowed.

methods.name: getFilterName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter that triggered this exception.
